verdict.rationale: Syncing busy blocks between calendars is a fair axis for a calendar product, but the evidence shows no built-in feature that automatically mirrors busy blocks between work and personal calendars. The free/busy query, push notifications, incremental sync and event-import API endpoints are developer building blocks a developer could use to construct such sync, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, busy blocks sync between my work and personal calendars automatically so all my schedules stay in step
